column1: # The single function words the reader and realiser name by role.
# to      infinitive_marker  opens an infinitive ("to go")
# have    have_lemma         the bare perfect auxiliary / possessive verb
# has     have_3sg           the third-person form of have_lemma
# never   negative_adverb    the adverb the frame stores as `never`
# did     past_do            the past do-support auxiliary
# you     address_pronoun    an object-form pronoun that may still open a clause
# it      expletive_pronoun  the empty subject of a weather verb
# etc     scaffold_abbrev    an abbreviation that marks a sentence as scaffolding
# a e i o u  vowel           vowel letters
